question: Iron mines in Jharkhand attributed to the rise of which of the following kingdoms in ancient India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Magadha.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The r**ise of Magadha kingdom** was attributed to the **iron mines in Jharkhand.**
 
• The iron ore available in Jharkhand region was of **high quality **and was extensively used for making **weapons and tools.**
 
• Magadha kingdom used this to its advantage and became a** powerful kingdom **in ancient India.
 
• The iron industry also led to the growth of other industries like **agriculture, trading, and metallurgy **in the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kuru kingdom** was located in the** northern part of India** and was known for its **military prowess.**

 
 
• Kuru was a Vedic Indo-Aryan tribal union that emerged in the** Middle Vedic period** in northern Iron Age India.
 
• It included parts of the present-day states of** Haryana, Delhi, **and some parts of western** Uttar Pradesh. **
 
 
 
• **Kashi kingdom** was situated in the present-day **Varanasi region of Uttar Pradesh** and was known for its **rich cultural heritage.**
 
 
• The Kasi kingdom occupied a** 300 league radius.**
 
• The** Sarpika or Syandika river **served as Kasi's northern boundary, dividing it from Kosala.​
 
 
 
• **Kushan kingdom** was a **Central Asian empire **that ruled over parts of modern-day **India, Pakistan, and Afghanistan.**
 
 
• It was known for its **trade and commerce.**
